transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (722x748) JPEG screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 22/12/2013 (day > 12, so D/M/Y is unambiguous) differs from the file name '131221'; the notes say the avalanche was 'the day before', so the file name likely names the avalanche date. Height axis 2.7 px/cm (10 cm gridlines); boundaries 92/76/50/25/10/9/0 from bar edges and the table's height-column lines (+-0.5 cm; 25 cm could be 25.5). Hardness axis is non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F labels at 216/108/54/27/12 px from the right edge); bars: F, 4F+ (33 px, just past 4F), 4F, F, K (thin line at 10-9 cm), F. Table columns R (slanted lines, '+', X) and S (30 in the surface row, 0 in every layer row) are not interpreted; described in comments/here only. No temperature profile drawn (theta column empty); Surface Temp -13.0 C kept in header notes only. Legend 'Hidden: Stress' shown under the chart.
